reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Verified the live branch carries only the intended follow-up commits; safe to adopt.
repairTrigger: Repair workspace — quarantine changes & restore branch
unassignedPick: unassigned — pick one to wake them
observingHint: Recovery is observing without interrupting the live run.
openHint: The card stays open until an explicit decision is recorded.
repairDescription: This is lossless — no reason required. Your uncommitted changes are committed onto a fresh rescue branch, then the recorded branch is restored so the task can resume. The live branch is left exactly as it is.
reissueDescription: Creates a fresh copy of this task on an isolated git worktree based on the live branch. Your current workspace and its commits are left untouched.
tryAgainDescription: Dismiss recovery and return the source task to todo.
markDoneDescription: Restore by recording the requested work as complete.
sendReviewDescription: Hand off to a reviewer with a real review path.
falseDoneDescription: Dismiss recovery and mark the source task complete.
falseReviewDescription: Dismiss recovery and send the source task for review.
breakGlassBefore: This overrides Paperclip's safety check and points the recorded workspace at the live branch
breakGlassAfter: . Confirm the divergence below and record why before continuing.
headlineMissing: This task's run finished, but no next step was chosen. Choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headlineWait: This task's last run stopped to wait, but there is no reviewer, blocker, monitor, or approval to wait for. Paperclip is repairing the next step; the task stays with its owner.
headlineStranded: Paperclip retried this task's last run, but there is still no queued run, reviewer, blocker, or other next owner. To get it moving, choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headlineWorkspace: Paperclip stopped this run because the task's git workspace could not be validated.
headlineConfiguration: Paperclip stopped before dispatching this run because required secret/env bindings are missing.
headlineWatchdog: The active run has been silent. Recovery is observing without interrupting it.
headlineNextStep: Paperclip could not find a clear next step for this open task. Choose whether to continue work, send it for review, mark it done, or record what is blocking it.
wakeOwner: An agent will be asked to choose the next step
wakeOriginal: Paperclip is retrying the original owner
wakeRecovery: A recovery owner is repairing the next step
nativeRecovering: Paperclip is recovering the existing run.
nativeExhausted: Paperclip could not recover the existing run within its retry budget. Review the recorded failure before retrying.
nativeExpired: The retry for the existing run came due and did not start. Review the recorded failure and retry when ready.
nativeScheduled: Paperclip has scheduled another attempt to resume the existing run.
nativeNeeded: The existing run still needs recovery. Review the recorded failure before retrying.
lineageExpired: This task's automatic retry came due and did not run, so nothing is moving it forward right now. Someone must retry it or record the next step.
lineageOwnerExhausted: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. The original owner has used every automatic repair attempt, so the next step needs a decision. The task stays with its owner.
lineageOwnerRetrying: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. Paperclip is retrying the original owner to record a real next step. The task stays with its owner, and no action is needed yet.
lineageRecovery: The original owner could not record a next step within its retry budget. A recovery owner is now repairing the path only — the task itself still belongs to its original owner.
lineageBoard: Automatic recovery is exhausted, so the board must choose the next step. The task itself still belongs to its original owner.
humanDecision: This recovery needs a human decision. Review the recorded failure and choose the next step.
retryDidNotRun: The scheduled retry did not run — a retry or a decision is needed
retriesFinished: Automatic retries are finished — a decision is needed
claimExplanation: — the lossless repair can't run while another workspace holds the live branch.
heldByReissue: Held by {{owner}} — re-issue on an isolated workspace instead.
ownerAttemptCount: The original owner used {{attempt}} of {{max}} automatic attempts.
workspaceRepairedBody: Dirty changes were quarantined onto a rescue branch and the recorded branch restored; the task will resume.
workspaceReconciledBody: The recorded branch now matches the live branch; the task will resume.
reconcileFailedBody: Unable to reconcile the workspace branch.
reissueCreatedBody: A fresh isolated re-issue was created.
reissueFailedBody: Unable to create an isolated re-issue.
createdRunBody: {{identifier}} will run on a fresh isolated workspace.
noReconcileWorkspace: This task has no execution workspace to reconcile.
noRepairWorkspace: This task has no execution workspace to repair.
